Added.Description: Specifies the rule identifier/expression that results in rule identifier of the parent rule. To perform this aggregation on the first level rules in the Rule Set, pass '*' as the rule identifier.
Specifies the rule identifier/expression that results in rule identifier of the parent rule. To perform this aggregation on the first level rules in the Rule Set, pass '*' as the rule identifier.

Specifies whether to only include the immediate children of the parent rule or to include all rules in the hierarchy of the parent rule. Default is No/False i.e., only consider immediate children. To perform this aggregation on all rules in the Rule Set, pass '*' as the rule identifier and specify this value as True.
